automation.vaultExplainTitle: What are OpenBao / Vault Compatible Routes (/v1/pki/*)?
automation.vaultExplainDesc: Many existing tools (Kubernetes cert-manager, Terraform, Vault CLI, Consul) already speak HashiCorp Vault / OpenBao PKI API. By exposing /v1/pki/issue/{profile} and /v1/pki/revoke, those tools can request certificates directly from this CA using your API token as X-Vault-Token — zero custom plugin required.
automation.acmeExplainTitle: What is the ACME Directory Endpoint (/acme/directory)?
automation.acmeExplainDesc: Full RFC 8555 ACME v2 server with External Account Binding (EAB), real HTTP-01 & DNS-01 (wildcard) domain validation, and ZeroSSL-style commercial quota separation: manual Web issuance follows tier limits while ACME issuance is unlimited (protected by hourly rate limits).
automation.acmeTitle: Commercial ACME v2 Server & External Account Binding (EAB)
automation.acmeSubtitle: Bind acme.sh, Certbot, Caddy, or Kubernetes cert-manager to your account via EAB (RFC 8555 §7.3.4). ACME certificates are unlimited and do not consume your manual Web quota.
automation.acmeEabNotice: Copy your EAB HMAC Key now — it is encrypted at rest and displayed only once.
